mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXERCISE_SESSION (user_id, exercise_type_id, exercise_date, total_count, duration_sec) VALUES (#{userId}, #{exerciseTypeId}, CURDATE(), 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE EXERCISE_SESSION es SET es.total_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EXERCISE_SCORE WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}), es.duration_sec = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, es.created_at, NOW()), es.accuracy = (SELECT AVG(action_score) FROM EXERCISE_SCORE WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}) WHERE es.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT es.session_id AS sessionId, et.body_part AS bodyPart, es.total_count AS totalCount, es.duration_sec AS durationSec, es.accuracy AS accuracy, es.video_path AS videoPath, es.exercise_date AS exerciseDate, es.user_id AS userId FROM EXERCISE_SESSION es JOIN EXERCISE_TYPE et ON es.exercise_type_id = et.exercise_type_id WHERE es.session_id = #{sessionId}
